title: Oven Roasted Ethiopian Beef Kitfo
description: A savory and crispy Ethiopian dish made with raw beef, spices, and herbs, served with a side of injera bread, perfect for a sick day or any day of the week, diabetic-friendly due to the use of minimal sugar and salt in the recipe.

ingredients.name: cure
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for food safety

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped beef, fast action yeast, cure, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spread the beef mixture out in a thin layer.
Roast the beef mixture in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until it is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the beef kitfo with a side of injera bread and your favorite vegetables or salad.
Traditionally, kitfo is served raw, but for food safety reasons, we are using the oven to cook the beef to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Make sure to handle the raw beef safely and cook it to the recommended internal temperature to avoid foodborne illness.
